ruminants have an important role to play in the future of food production, as long as the production system is adapted to the specificities of the region, the environment, and the consumer demand.
ruminant production should be intensified in a sustainable way to feed the planet.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the future of ruminant farming will depend on the capacity of ruminant producers to meet the challenges posed by globalisation and urbanisation, and to adapt their farming systems to the new demands of the consumers and to the new environmental conditions.

the sustainable intensification and diversification of animal production, including ruminant production, is a necessary and feasible solution to the global challenge of feeding the planet in the future.

, although ruminants are the main source of greenhouse gases, they are an important source of high quality animal proteins for human consumption, which is necessary to feed a growing world population.
